features: BEST QUALITY AND GREAT COMBINATION PACKAGE-Great quality "Happy Birthday" Banner, pom poms and hanging swirls included in one package. Get a beautiful decorative banner and the best birthday party decorations with one purchase.

DESIGN OF BANNER-13 Pennants in all colors with single letters that spell out "HAPPY BIRTHDAY". Two separate strands, one says "HAPPY" the other "BIRTHDAY". Product is made with card stock & satin ribbons that hold individual letter cards on each strand. Simple assembly.
SIMPLE ASSEMBLY-Easy to string the banner onto the ribbon as well as simple DIY pom pom assembly and hang as desired together with the hanging swirls.
EASY STEP-BY-STEP INSTRUCTIONS-DIY assembly of quality paper pom poms. Follow the simple instructions for easy assembly of decorative balls. Refer to images..

VERSATILE DECORATION SET-Easy to hang the pom poms, banner, and streamers anywhere! Attach them to a ceiling, wall, or table. This decoration set can be used as a photography backdrop as well as to enhance any princess's birthday party celebration.
description: Enjoy this bundle which includes a Happy Birthday Banner, 6 pom poms, and 6 hanging swirls . This will surely enhance any party celebrations.
